integrity: Proof and a standalone exact-fraction finite verifier included; finite checks are not the proof. No experimental, independent or third-party mathematical certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional fixed CPTP steps and renewal resetting to a fixed state, with every age hazard strictly between zero and one. Necessity is universal over quantum systems, not specific to each fixed system. No theorem is asserted for endpoint hazards, existence of steady states, Heisenberg-picture divisibility, or quantum process-tensor Markovianity. Earlier broad semi-Markov results or separate supplements could affect publication priority.
title: Increasing reset hazards exactly characterize universal quantum channel divisibility
